Title: AI-Prompt-Engineering-Playground: Free interactive OER for learning AI Prompt Engineering
Description:
AI Prompt Engineering Playground is a free, interactive Open Educational Resource (OER) for structured self-learning in AI Prompt Engineering. The platform guides learners through six progressive levels — from foundational prompt writing to advanced production-ready techniques — with no registration, no cost, and no prerequisites required.

Topics covered include: prompt basics, zero-shot and few-shot prompting, chain-of-thought reasoning, role prompting, reusable prompt patterns, token optimization, A/B testing, domain-specific applications (code, content, data analysis, business), and production safety practices including prompt injection defense.

The resource features 100+ hands-on interactive exercises, real-time prompt scoring, a pattern library with copyable templates, a token counter tool, and knowledge quizzes at each level. Progress is saved automatically in the browser.

Suitable for undergraduate and postgraduate students, educators integrating AI literacy into curricula, and self-directed learners building applied Generative AI skills. Licensed under MIT — free to use, adapt, and share.
